$note: StreamKeyBinding v2 (version 0x02) with one composite signature: v1's six members, then codec_map (u8 count, then class u8 || u16 len || ASCII token, sorted by class), replaces (u8 0|1 [|| stream_id]), end u8 (0 none, 1 Left, 2 Backgrounded, 3 Ended), final_seq u64 BE iff end != 0, kind u8, framing u8, profile u8 (0 best-effort, 1 accountable); then u16 3373 || composite. Signing bytes 'ciris-edge:av-stream-key:v2' || body. stream_id is CC rc21's v3 derivation (length-prefixed room and publisher). Inputs: publisher member-kat-a (a member key, never a node key) Ed25519 01x32 / ML-DSA-65 54x32, room-kat, join nonce 07x32, epoch 5, chunk key 0cx32. Generated with dilithium-py (deterministic) and pyca/cryptography.

cases.description: Codec map av1 (class 0x01) and opus (0xFF); replaces the stream of join nonce 08x32; end Backgrounded (2) with final_seq 41; kind media; framing fragments; profile accountable.
Profile accountable at the floor: head_interval_s 30.
Codec map opus (0xFF) only; no replaces; no end (so no final_seq); kind media; framing none; profile best-effort.

refusals.description: Profile accountable with no head_interval_s: a truncated encoding, refused.

stream_id_rule: SHA-256('ciris-edge:call-stream:v3' || u16be len || room || u16be len || publisher || join_nonce[32]); room and publisher 1..=1024 bytes UTF-8
